themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, analyze data, and even interact with systems to achieve research goals.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content related to AI tools and techniques for condensing large amounts of text, such as meeting notes, research papers, or user feedback, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools designed to help developers write, debug, and maintain code, improving efficiency and productivity in software development.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Broad coverage of various AI-powered tools and platforms designed to aid in the research process, from data collection to analysis and insight generation.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Discussions on how AI is affecting jobs, skills, hiring, and the overall labor market, including research on potential job displacement and new roles.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on studies and analyses of AI chatbots, their capabilities, limitations, ethical implications, and user interactions, particularly concerning their impact on user behavior and perception.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Articles detailing how AI is being used to assist in the design process, including generating UI elements, prototyping, and exploring design concepts.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Content related to AI applications for creating, distributing, and analyzing surveys, aiming to improve efficiency and extract deeper insights from survey data.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Articles exploring the use of AI to create artificial user profiles or personas for testing and research, and the implications of AI-generated content mimicking human output.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in qualitative research methods, such as analyzing interview transcripts, coding verbatim responses, and identifying themes in open-ended feedback.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
